truth_factorized_cross_checks.original_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie_companies mc,title t,movie_info_idx mi_idx WHERE t.id=mc.movie_id AND t.id=mi_idx.movie_id AND mi_idx.info_type_id=112 AND mc.company_type_id=2;
truth_factorized_cross_checks.executed_sql:
WITH exact_titles AS (SELECT t.id FROM title t),
exact_g0 AS (SELECT mc.movie_id, COUNT(*)::numeric AS n FROM movie_companies mc WHERE mc.company_type_id=2 GROUP BY mc.movie_id),
exact_g1 AS (SELECT mi_idx.movie_id, COUNT(*)::numeric AS n FROM movie_info_idx mi_idx WHERE mi_idx.info_type_id=112 GROUP BY mi_idx.movie_id)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(exact_g0.n * exact_g1.n),0) FROM exact_titles exact_t JOIN exact_g0 ON exact_g0.movie_id=exact_t.id JOIN exact_g1 ON exact_g1.movie_id=exact_t.id;
